      (c) => { const d = DAYS[c.v%7], ans = dayAfter(d); return single(c,"day after",`Which day comes after ${d}?`,ans,[dayBefore(d),DAYS[(DAYS.indexOf(d)+2)%7],d],`${ans} follows ${d}.`); },
      (c) => { const d = DAYS[(c.v+2)%7], ans = dayBefore(d); return single(c,"day before",`Which day comes before ${d}?`,ans,[dayAfter(d),DAYS[(DAYS.indexOf(d)+5)%7],d],`${ans} comes before ${d}.`); },
